_doc: Festivals + cultural moments by market. Keys = market code. Each entry: { date (MM-DD), name, weight (1-10 commercial relevance), tags, archetype_hint, recommended_segments }. Universal coverage across every market KNICKGASM ships to.

US.name: Super Bowl Sunday (2026: Feb 8) — VARIABLE, 2nd Sunday of February
US.why: Football/sports collection — US sports-fandom customs and halftime-culture moment for the US shipping market
US.source: Well-known fact: Super Bowl LX played Feb 8, 2026 (NFL schedules the game the 2nd Sunday of February)

US.name: Pokemon Day
US.why: Anime collection — Pokemon hand-painted AF1/Dunks; Pokemon Company runs official Pokemon Day announcements annually on Feb 27 (anniversary of 1996 Red/Green release)

US.name: Air Max Day
US.why: AF1/sneaker-culture core — Nike's official sneaker holiday (Mar 26, anniversary of the 1987 Air Max 1); peak sneakerhead attention for a Nike-canvas customiser
US.source: https://www.nike.com/air-max-day (Nike official, celebrated Mar 26 annually since 2014)

US.name: National Pet Day (US)
US.why: Pets collection — pet-portrait custom sneakers for the US market

US.name: Star Wars Day (May the 4th)
US.why: Gaming/pop-culture collection — Star Wars-themed customs; Disney/Lucasfilm promote May 4 officially each year

US.name: Goku Day
US.why: Anime collection — Dragon Ball customs are a hero SKU for anime customisers; May 9 ('Go-Ku' in Japanese numerals) is certified by the Japan Anniversary Association and promoted by Toei
US.source: https://en.dragon-ball-official.com/news/ (Toei's official Dragon Ball site promotes Goku Day, May 9, annually)

US.name: One Piece Day
US.why: Anime collection — One Piece customs; Jul 22 is the anniversary of the manga's 1997 serialization, celebrated with official annual One Piece Day events by Shueisha/Toei
US.source: https://one-piece-day.com/ (official One Piece Day event site)

US.name: International Cat Day
US.why: Pets collection — cat-portrait customs and UGC; Aug 8 established by International Fund for Animal Welfare
US.source: https://www.ifaw.org/journal/international-cat-day (IFAW, custodian of International Cat Day, Aug 8)

US.name: International/National Dog Day
US.why: Pets collection — dog-portrait custom sneakers are a proven personalisation SKU; Aug 26 observed annually

US.name: National Video Games Day (US)
US.why: Gaming collection — game-franchise customs (US observance, Sep 12; distinct from Sep 29 'Video Games Day')

US.name: International Coffee Day
US.why: Coffee collection — coffee-themed customs; Oct 1 designated by the International Coffee Organization since 2015

US.name: Black Friday / Cyber Monday (2026: Nov 27-30) — VARIABLE, 4th Friday of November
US.why: All collections — biggest global e-commerce discount window; key for the 60+ country shipping audience and AF1 base customs
US.source: Well-known fact: Black Friday is the day after US Thanksgiving (4th Thursday of Nov); in 2026 that is Nov 27

US.name: Taylor Swift's Birthday
US.why: Taylor Swift collection — Swiftie eras-themed customs; Dec 13 (b. 1989) is the recurring fandom date Swifties celebrate annually
US.source: Well-known fact: Taylor Swift born Dec 13, 1989 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Swift)

US.name: Christmas (order-cutoff campaign from late Nov given custom lead times)
US.why: All collections — peak Western gifting; critical for Knickgasm's international shipping markets, with early-order messaging due to hand-painting lead time
US.source: Well-known fact: Christmas is Dec 25 worldwide
